gridDNA: A dominant vertical product shot occupies the left column, while a multi-sectioned text column with associated visual proof elements fills the right. A distinct dark horizontal band at the bottom houses a sub-headline, a row of smaller proof images, a retailer logo, and a prominent CTA button, all against a solid background with a small disclaimer at the very bottom.

typeScale: headline ~5% of canvas height, sub-headline ~3.5%, mini-headlines ~3%, body ~2%, disclaimer ~1%
colourBlocking: top 72% is solid red, bottom 23% is a solid dark blue/black band, very bottom 5% is solid red again for the disclaimer
negativeSpace: Ample solid red background provides breathing room around the product, headline, and body text, making them stand out. The dark bottom band also uses negative space to clearly frame the action-oriented elements.
eyePath: The eye starts at the top-left brand logo and headline, moves down to the dominant product bottle, then across to the structured body copy and the large visual proof graphic. It then drops to the sub-headline, scans the row of smaller proof images, and finally lands on the prominent CTA button.
whyItWins: The layout effectively combines a hero product shot with structured, benefit-driven copy and compelling visual proof, guiding the eye directly to a clear call to action within a distinct action zone.
